item.title: FDO Code of Confuct
item.description: As part of the 2022 conference in Leiden the FDOF developed participation guidelines which we see as a Code of Conduct guiding all activities of the FDOF. We expect any FDOF member to act according to these guidelines.

item.title: FDO Compliance Profiles
item.description: This page will provide a comprehensive overview of the different implementations that adhere to the specification. This page will highlight real-world examples across various platforms, programming languages, and tools, offering developers insight into how the specification is being applied in practice. Each implementation will be documented with details on compatibility, features, usage examples, and links to source code or repositories, helping users choose the right solution for their needs and encouraging further contributions and interoperability.

item.title: FDO Specifications
item.description:
Specifications

Our FDO architecture specification is now developed on GitHub using modern, collaborative practices. With transparent version control, pull requests, and issue tracking, we ensure faster, more reliable updates and greater community involvement—making the process clearer, more efficient, and fully traceable.

Older Documents

Please note that older references are no longer maintained and may contain outdated or inconsistent information. For the most accurate and up-to-date details, always refer to the current specification hosted on GitHub.
